headline: Why Is My Gas Grill Flame Weak or Uneven?
articleBody: Having a weak or uneven flame on your gas grill can be super frustrating, especially when you’re trying to cook up a delicious meal. There are a few common culprits behind this issue, and understanding them can help you know when it’s time to call in the pros. Often, a weak flame is due to an obstruction in the gas line or the burner tubes themselves. Debris, grease, or even spiders can get into these components and restrict gas flow. Another possibility is a low gas supply, which could be an issue with your propane tank (if it’s running low) or a problem with the natural gas line pressure. Sometimes, a faulty regulator can also be to blame, as it controls the gas pressure reaching your burners. If you've checked your tank or supply and the problem persists, it's really best to have an expert take a look.
